title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（花岡大伸研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Hanaoka Daishin)
teachers:
HANAOKA Daishin
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
In order to solve problems related to the renewal and maintenance of construction
materials and civil engineering structures, we propose methods for overcoming issues and solving problems by engineering means (experiment, analysis, investigation, etc.).
advice:
Project activities are designed to impel students to think and act on their own while receiving guidance from the teacher.
In principle, each person carries out one project theme.

[First semester]
Organize the background of the project theme and past research, determine the purpose of the theme (target), and plan and implement engineering means (experiments, analyses, surveys, etc.) to achieve the purpose with guidance from the teacher.

[Second semester]
The project planned in the previous semester will be implemented and the results will be reviewed. The results will be summarized as a design report and presented orally.
Students design their theme by themselves and solve their selected problems.

A total of 450 hours or more of study are required.
requiredKnowledge:
Environmental Materials, Reinforced Concrete, Disaster Prevention Engineering I,
Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises A & B

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Students can fully explain reasonable construction and advanced maintenance for concrete structures.
(2) Students can do all necessary experiments, analyses, and investigations by themselves.
(3) Students can present and report their results and discuss them fully.
(4) Students act in full accordance with engineering ethics.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Students can understand reasonable construction and advanced maintenance for concrete structures.
(2) Students can perform experiments, analyses, and investigations with graduate students.
(3) Students can present and report results and discuss them.
(4) Students act in accordance with engineering ethics.
